department: Biomedical Sciences Graduate Program, School of Medicine

deadline.value: Priority deadline December 31, 2026; admissions are rolling after that.

app_fee.value: No application fee for the biomedical sciences PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE or MCAT scores are not required, but are evaluated if sent.
gre_general.quote: GRE or MCAT scores are not required but will be evaluated if provided.

gre_subject.quote: GRE or MCAT scores are not required but will be evaluated if provided.

toefl_min.quote: For the PhD program, minimum scores of 90 for the TOEFL or 7.0 overall band score for the IELTS are normally required.

ielts_min.value: The PhD normally requires IELTS 7.0 overall.
ielts_min.quote: For the PhD program, minimum scores of 90 for the TOEFL or 7.0 overall band score for the IELTS are normally required.

english_waiver.value: Applicants need TOEFL or IELTS, or other evidence of English proficiency; the page does not name an English-medium degree.
english_waiver.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) scores, International English Language Testing System (IELTS) scores, or other evidence of English proficiency are required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to name faculty members whose research is of interest in their personal statement.
supervisor.quote: You will also be asked to include the names of any Tulane School of Medicine faculty members whose research is of interest.

funding.value: All PhD students receive a full tuition waiver, paid health insurance and a stipend of approximately $35,000 per year.
funding.quote: All PhD students receive a full tuition waiver, paid health insurance and a stipend of approximately $35,000 per year for the entire duration of the program, usually between four and seven years.

notes: School of Medicine program with its own application: no fee, GRE optional, TOEFL 90 or IELTS 7 normally. Funding, supervisor and entry route are not stated on the fetched pages.
